_doc: Datapad environments. ONE built file (ui/genesis_datapad.html, from build_datapad.py) is published to every environment; only the artifact URL, database and processor wiring differ. Live is updated in place (same URL) only with owner approval; tests and previews go to stage.

stage.processor: none (no_processor); a session drives the real processor flow by hand

capabilities.db: same rules as live; no mcp

rollback.note: republish the previous built file to the live URL, then git revert the merge; never force-push
